newsitem.title: FRANCE: French farmers promised aid for drought, frost.
newsitem.headline: French farmers promised aid for drought, frost.

text.p: PARIS, April 23 (reuter) - French Farm Minister Philippe Vasseur said on Wednesday he was putting an aid programme in place to compensate farmers for damage caused by drought and frost but did not say how much he had in mind.
He also said he would set up a drought alert centre at national level by the end of the week as well as frost monitoring centres at the level of French administrative departments.
The deparments concerned are Bouches-du-Rhone, the Var, the Vaucluse, the Drome and the Gard departments, all in the south of France.
The measures were announced in a farm ministry statement.
Some drought compensation aid is already available but the minister said payment procedures would be speeded up.
Farmers will also be allowed to delay payment of social security contributions and if necessary to seek help with bank debts, he said.
